summary: Frontend-only PWA test (390x844) for Iter 504-505: Tasks bottom tab + Task Management bento + task edit + edit log. Home screen verifications PASSED: bento-tasks tile visible, row-task-management quick action visible, 'Tasks' bottom tab visible. Tasks tab (/tasks) verifications PASSED: tasks-tab-screen renders, pd-tasks-panel present, pd-task-add ('New Task') button present, filter chips present. TASK EDIT / EDIT LOG / NEW-TASK regression flows were NOT fully verified end-to-end via UI due to (a) heavy Cloudflare 429 rate-limiting on the preview URL when the automation drove clicks in quick succession, and (b) the RN dev-error overlay ('Uncaught Error: Security check in progress') stacking on every 429 and blocking click interactions until many manual Dismiss presses. Root-cause of a testing blocker also found: demo task task_1ea42927d008 was created with company_id=null; the mobile Tasks panel (via SelectedCompanyContext) always calls /admin/portal-tasks?company_id=<selectedCid> when a firm is selected (super-admin auto-locks to Kankani cmp_527fecdd7c), and the backend query {$or:[{company_id:cid},{company_ids:cid}]} filters out null-company tasks — so the demo task was invisible in the UI. Testing agent patched the demo task's company_id to cmp_527fecdd7c (via authenticated PATCH) so it becomes visible in the panel; edited_count is now 1 (backend edit-log incremented from that PATCH). Code review of TasksPanel.tsx confirms edit modal ('Edit Task' title), title/desc/due/priority prefill, Assign-to section hidden when editFor is truthy, pd-task-save PATCH handler, edited badge pd-task-history-<id>, and pd-history-close are all wired correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Global/unassigned tasks (company_id=null) are invisible in the Tasks tab whenever a firm is auto-selected via SelectedCompanyContext. Super Admin PWA locks to Kankani on load, so any global-scope task never renders. Repro: create task via POST /admin/portal-tasks with company_id=null -> open /tasks as super_admin with Kankani selected -> task missing from list. Fix options: (a) add a 'Global (all firms)' scope include when companyId is set, (b) surface a 'Clear firm filter' chip in Tasks tab, or (c) send both scoped and unscoped queries and merge.

When Cloudflare 429s the /admin/portal-tasks call, /src/api/client.ts throws 'Security check in progress' which surfaces as an RN dev red-box that STACKS per subsequent 429 (Log 1 of N). In the preview env under quick user taps this blocks all further clicks. Consider swallowing 429 silently with an inline toast + auto-retry (backoff) instead of throwing, so users can keep interacting.

action_items: Decide on scope-inclusion strategy so global (company_id=null) tasks show up in the Tasks tab even when a firm is selected — otherwise any 'unassigned' task is invisible in PWA.
Consider silencing the 'Security check in progress' red-box for 429s (make it an inline toast) so intermittent Cloudflare rate-limits don't cover the tap targets in preview/prod.

For future automated PWA testing of Tasks flows, ensure demo tasks are scoped to the firm the super-admin session auto-locks to (cmp_527fecdd7c for this env), or clear the 'skc:selected_company' localStorage key before test.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.tsx is ~1185 lines — nearing the 700-line guideline; consider extracting the Edit modal, Recurring modal, Attachments modal, and Edit-Log modal into sibling files for maintainability.

Edit-vs-Create branching in createTask() is correct (Assign-to only rendered when !editFor), and PATCH body includes title/description/due_date/priority/company_id which matches backend field-by-field audit expectation.

success_rate.frontend: ~40% verified end-to-end via UI; remaining ~60% verified via code review + backend curl due to preview-env rate-limiting

seed_data_creation: Patched existing task_1ea42927d008 via PATCH /api/admin/portal-tasks/task_1ea42927d008 to set company_id=cmp_527fecdd7c (needed so it becomes visible in the auto-firm-scoped Tasks panel). Side effect: edited_count is now 1 on that task (from that PATCH itself); backend audit trail contains that CREATED + one EDITED entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The demo task task_1ea42927d008 has been re-scoped to Kankani (cmp_527fecdd7c) and its edited_count is 1. It is now VISIBLE in Tasks tab for super_admin with Kankani auto-selected. To retest Step 3-5 cleanly: (1) log in via localStorage llc_session_token (password_...), (2) navigate to /tasks, (3) find pd-task-edit-task_1ea42927d008 (should be near top of list because it has newest created_at among Kankani-scoped tasks), (4) proceed with edit/log/new-task per E1 checklist. When automation runs, expect Cloudflare 429s -> RN dev-overlay 'Security check in progress' — call a robust Dismiss loop (click all buttons with text 'Dismiss' repeatedly, up to 20 times) after every click, or slow down the flow with 2-3s waits between taps. Consider adding await page.wait_for_timeout(2500) after each click to avoid 429s.
rca_of_issue: Demo task not appearing in UI list: root cause is data-scoping mismatch — task was created global (company_id=null) but PWA super-admin session locks to a firm via SelectedCompanyContext -> panel query always includes ?company_id=<cid> -> backend $or:[{company_id:cid},{company_ids:cid}] excludes null-company docs. Mitigation applied: patched task company_id to cmp_527fecdd7c. Long-term fix: E1 should ensure demo/global tasks are visible regardless of firm selection (either surface Global tasks in every firm scope, or provide a Clear firm chip in the Tasks tab). RN dev overlay for 429s (Iter 93/103 code path in /src/api/client.ts:151-173) is working as designed but is UX-hostile in preview env — throwing Error stacks in the ErrorBoundary/LogBox.
